chunks: It is incumbent upon me not to say about Allah except the truth. I have come to you with a clear proof from your Lord, so send forth with me the Children of Israel.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'I have come to you with a clear proof' refer to in the context of the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a declaration of prophetic authenticity, where the 'clear sign' (bayyinah) refers not only to miracles but also to the Prophet's own personhood and the Imams as the enduring proof of God. It underscores the divine mandate to liberate the faithful from spiritual and physical bondage, a theme central to the concept of Wilayah and the guidance provided by the Ahl al-Bayt.
